messages:
billing-bot: New invoice INV-50312 posted for Beacon Partners — total $9,210.40 (usage + connectors). Link: https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-50312

ana (Customer Success): Beacon says the new S3 connector duplicated objects for two days after the 9/02 deploy and they were charged for duplicate ingestion. They want a refund/credit for the duplicate volume.

jess (Finance): Do we have the usage breakdown? How many duplicate units and what's their tier?

leo (Billing Ops): Pulled usage: total duplicate tokens = 8,500,000 across 2024-09-02 00:10 to 2024-09-03 23:50 UTC. Their plan blended rate = $0.00085/token -> potential credit $7,225.

max (Partner Eng): Root cause: connector retry loop introduced by recent change in the partner adapter. We've patched the loop at 09/03 02:15 UTC and backfilled de-dupe for future reads. Logs attached to CS ticket.

ana (Customer Success): Beacon wants either a refund or a billing credit applied to next invoice. Prefers credit memo.

jess (Finance): For refunds >$5k we need Finance Lead sign-off and Legal notified (risk of precedent). I'll draft a credit memo but will hold until approval.

cory (Finance Lead): I'm OK to approve a one-time credit of $7,225 as goodwill for a confirmed platform/adapter bug. Conditions: label as "partner connector duplication - one-time credit", add invoice note, and record GL: 4105; journal id: CRD-BEACON-20240904. Also notify partner program.

leo (Billing Ops): Posting journal now. Journal entry: `CRD-BEACON-20240904 | GL 4105 | Amount 7225.00 | Reason: connector duplication credit`. Will reissue invoice INV-50312 -> INV-50312-R and attach CM-7810.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-7810 created for INV-50312-R amount $7,225.00 (status: pending).

jess (Finance): Confirmed. Notifying Legal and Partner Ops. We'll mark this as "one-time" in billing to avoid automated policy changes.

ana (Customer Success): Let Beacon know it's issued and applied to next billing. I'll include a short note describing the patch and our mitigation steps.

max (Partner Eng): We'll add a monitoring alert to detect duplicate ingestion patterns and rollout fix to all connectors this week.

cory (Finance Lead): Thanks all. Keep ticket linked to the credit memo and include the RCA in the internal postmortem. :thumbsup:
